_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.title: Backlog work intake
requirements.description: The system shall let operators and agents create backlog items (idea, research, fix, execute, chore) directly, from classified captures, and from accepted proposals

validation.notes: TestCreate_Success (direct create) and TestCreate_StoresAgentProvenanceFromIdentityMiddleware (agent-created item) write a real backlog spec.json.
TestCreateItem_Success creates a backlog item from a classified capture via the BacklogItemCreator.
TestApply_AddItem_CreatesItemAndAttaches and TestApply_SkipsUnacceptedMutations create items only from accepted proposals.

requirements.title: Canonical work package
requirements.description: Each meaningful implementation backlog item shall retain one canonical Plan Manager plan whose shape (phased or mandate) is a field on the plan; the item shall carry the grant and execution settings for that plan

validation.notes: TestApplyPlanCandidateClearsAcceptanceAfterPlanManagerApply revises the item's single plan in place (candidate preview/apply against the one PlanRef). The exactly-one-plan-per-item uniqueness invariant is not separately asserted (audit 2026-07-23).
TestDevelopmentWorkShapeCannotFallThroughToPlanExecution preserves ordinary plan dispatch and refuses a retained contract item. Backlog creation and next-action projection remain incomplete.

requirements.title: Plan workshop loop
requirements.description: When a workshop round runs, the system shall present typed proposals and open decisions and shall change the plan only through operator-approved responses

validation.notes: TestReviewRunProjectsTypedResultOnce projects typed proposals + open decisions; TestProposalResponseRequiresOneReconciliation and TestApplyReconciliationCreatesCandidateWithoutCanonicalApply change the plan only through operator-approved responses (canonical apply requires acknowledgement).

requirements.title: Revision-bound acceptance gate
requirements.description: The system shall block execution until the operator accepts the current plan content hash together with the item's execution settings and acceptance globs, and shall clear acceptance when any of them changes

validation.notes: TestAcceptPlanPinsCanonicalHashAndScopeVersion (operator accept pins canonical hash) and TestPlanAcceptanceIsClearedWhenWorkContractChanges (acceptance cleared when the plan/contract changes).

TestResolveNextActionDecisionTable asserts the 'not been explicitly accepted' preflight reason maps to AcceptPlan. The execution-side queue block (execution/preflight.go planAcceptanceBlockingReason) has no direct execution-package test yet (audit 2026-07-23).
Retained bytes, source drift, concurrent approval versions, amendments and verified-human decision checks. This does not qualify a launch adapter.

requirements.title: Strategy-selectable execution
requirements.description: When an accepted item is run, the system shall let the operator select an execution strategy from a declared strategy registry

validation.notes: TestStrategies_ReturnsDeclaredExecutionChoiceWithCost exposes the declared strategy registry (with cost) to the operator. The in-repo registry currently declares one strategy (phased-plan-drain).
TestQueueBacklogRejectsUnknownStrategy validates operator strategy selection against the declared registry (unknown strategy rejected).

requirements.title: Phased slice execution
requirements.description: While a phased execution runs, the system shall implement and validate one plan slice at a time with access to prior-slice handoffs, per-slice review, and bounded correction turns

validation.notes: TestStartBindsIdempotentPlanManagerExecutionIntoWorkflowInput (bounded maxSlices + handoff plumbing), TestApplyPhasedPlanWorkflow_BlockedExactlyOnce (per-slice blocker/handoff + review pause), TestApprovePhasedPlanWorkflow_PersistsDecisionBeforeIdempotentSignal (per-slice review gate). The per-slice implement/correction-turn internals are exercised in the agent-manager scenario workflow, not here (audit 2026-07-23).

requirements.title: Independent post-run review
requirements.description: When an execution completes, the system shall produce an independent review verdict over the deliverable, baseline diff, and test evidence as advisory input to the operator

validation.notes: TestStartReview_StartsDeclaredWorkflowAndWritesRound and TestApplyWorkflowRound_ExactlyOnce produce a typed review verdict; TestBuildReviewAttachments_BaselineDiffPresentIffData asserts the review packet carries deliverable, changed-paths/diff, and test-evidence inputs.
TestSummarizeFinalization_RegressionGatesWhenEnabled and siblings assert the review verdict combined over baseline-diff evidence.

requirements.title: Operator-owned terminal decisions
requirements.description: The system shall reach a terminal item status (completed, failed, needs follow-up) only through an explicit operator review decision

validation.notes: TestReviewDecide_AcceptFromReviewPending and TestReviewDecide_FollowupMapsToNeedsFollowup reach terminal status only via the operator review-decide path; TestUpdatePatch_HTTP_RejectsStatusChangeFromReviewStates blocks generic PATCH from setting a terminal status out of review states.

requirements.title: Typed follow-up proposals
requirements.description: When review or execution surfaces further work, the system shall record one typed follow-up instruction with steering text and a dispatch disposition (follow_up_run, replan, or new_items) for operator decision in the ranked inbox

validation.notes: TestAutomaticFollowUpPolicyIsExplicitAndBounded asserts typed FollowUpProposal auto-apply is denied by default (operator decides).

TestFollowUp_SourceProposalIsExactlyOnce records a typed follow-up run/correction from a source proposal exactly once; dispatch tests cover follow_up_run, replan, and new_items through the persisted inbox instruction. TestFollowUp_OnlyCalledFromHandlerLifecycle (followup_callers_test.go) forbids any auto-follow-up path.

requirements.title: Item next-action projection
requirements.description: The system shall give every open backlog item and active goal exactly one enabled primary next action, using the same typed preflight checks that gate execution and exposing a ranked cross-entity feed

validation.notes: TestResolveNextActionDecisionTable (9-row table mapping shared ProcessPreflight reasons to the single recommended action) and TestNextActionEndpointsSingleAndBoundedBatch (single + bounded-batch endpoints).

requirements.title: Goals with milestones
requirements.description: The system shall model goals as operator intent statements with owned milestones, each carrying acceptance criteria over member backlog items, and shall let only an operator close out a goal as achieved after every milestone is verified-delivered

validation.notes: TestService_MilestonesAreOwnedScopedAndRoundTrip (goal-owned, scoped milestones over member items) and TestService_CreateComputesScopeAndBaseline (goal created from operator intent). Acceptance-criteria-over-member-items is not directly asserted (audit 2026-07-23).
TestConnectService_GoalAndMilestoneLifecycle: create goal -> create milestone -> assign items over the Connect RPC surface.

requirements.title: Goal planning loop
requirements.description: When goal planning runs, the system shall clarify goal intent and emit typed proposals (milestones, acceptance criteria, item assignments, new backlog items) into the operator's decision inbox

validation.notes: TestGoalTransitionAdapterProjectsSharedJournalAndRecordsReceipt starts the declared goal.plan transition, projects its typed proposal receipt exactly once, and retains the shared journal for recovery. 'Clarify goal intent' is the workflow's internal job and is not separately asserted.

requirements.title: Milestone review on completion
requirements.description: When all member items of a milestone reach terminal status, the system shall review the milestone's acceptance criteria against repository evidence and propose follow-up items for unmet criteria

validation.notes: No coverage yet: milestone review-on-completion (goals/workflow.go StartMilestoneReviewsForTerminalItem / allMilestoneItemsTerminal) is untested — no test exercises all-members-terminal -> evaluate acceptance criteria against repository evidence -> propose follow-up items. Only TestMilestoneWorkflowLaunchRejectsUnknownMilestone (a 404 guard) is adjacent (audit 2026-07-23).

requirements.title: Governed workflow execution
requirements.description: The system shall run all agentic work through declared agent-manager workflows whose prompts are canon-conformant contract skills with typed result schemas, dispatched through the registered transition catalog

validation.notes: TestRegisteredWorkflowNodesUseGovernedPromptReferences (every workflow node uses a governed contract-skill promptRef; inline templates rejected), TestValidateRejectsWorkflowMechanismFields, TestDeclaredRegistryCoversEveryTargetTransition.
TestWorkflowServiceCommandResultHandshake asserts the typed workflow input/output result contract via the agent-manager seam.
TestNoDirectAgentSpawnInDomainPackages: AST guardrail that domain packages never spawn agents directly, so all agentic work routes through declared workflows.
TestWorkflowTransportIsOwnedByTransitionRunner prevents domain packages from bypassing the shared transition runner with direct workflow transport calls.
TestTransitionServiceDispatchesGenericStartAndApply and TestTransitionServiceDispatchesDeterministicTransition prove the catalog service dispatches workflow and deterministic transitions.
Contract-development implementation and qualification are pending; no passing outcome evidence is asserted.

Two repairs under one approval, repository reopen, ambiguous start reservation, unknown usage, cancellation and overrun accounting. Native/fallback execution-owner wiring and monetary/delegated usage remain pending.

requirements.title: Plan-backed continuity
requirements.description: While an accepted item runs in either execution mode, the system shall permit successive authorized repairs under one item, resume only involuntary interruptions when the item declares continuation until-allowance, treat an agent verdict of complete, blocked or abstained as final, and preserve aggregate incurred and reserved usage, checkpoints, cancellation and budget limits across resumes and restarts

validation.notes: Contract-development implementation and qualification are pending; no passing outcome evidence is asserted.
Owner receipt fixture tests reject missing, stale, failed, future and wrong target/source/run/product evidence. Production outcome resolvers remain pending.

requirements.title: Evidence-bound finalization
requirements.description: When an execution ends, the system shall resolve required outcome evidence against the accepted plan in finalization and refuse acceptance of missing, stale, failed or mismatched evidence regardless of harness completion

validation.notes: Contract-development implementation and qualification are pending; no passing outcome evidence is asserted.
Typed approval, retained artifact reads and unauthenticated refusal.
Read-only preview and explicit version-bound approval transport; no launch.
Review invalidation, bound approval, error visibility and no incidental start. Full next-action and acceptance-decision UI remain pending.

requirements.title: Run review surface
requirements.description: The system shall expose the plan reference and shape, execution mode, limits, continuation and scope policy, operator note, composed goal message, progress, evidence and launch blockers through consistent API, CLI and board views before the operator runs an item
